spec.description: Must be open-company/v0. This generation is experimental.

id.description: Product id. Must equal the directory name under products/. Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$.

lifecycle.description: explore, live, maintain, or frozen. May be changed at import.

git.description: Repository URL. The importer checks out commit.

commit.description: Hex SHA, 7–64 characters, case-insensitive. Revision to check out.

path.description: Snapshot directory, relative to this Productfile. Must be ./code.

commit.description: Hex SHA of the snapshot's origin commit. Provenance only; not a checkout target.

branch.description: Branch name for the new repository created on import.

source.description: Exactly one of git or path. A local checkout is not a third form.

requires.description: Names the importer must prepare. Omit when empty.

secrets.description: Secret names the importer must prepare. Names only, never values.

logins.description: Platform names a person logs into on their own machine. Names only.

groups.description: Groups in list order. Omit when empty.

projects.description: Projects. Tasks are not listed here. Omit when empty.

group.description: Optional group id from groups in the same Productfile.

$comment: Generated with zod v4 z.toJSONSchema from the field constraints of productfileSchema. The exported schema wraps objects in a transform so vendor keys matching ^x-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*$ are accepted and other unknown keys are rejected; JSON Schema cannot represent that transform, so those keys are patternProperties on each object. Hex commit patterns are case-insensitive in the source schema; toJSONSchema dropped the i flag, so the class is expanded to [0-9a-fA-F]. open-company/v0 is experimental and matches the Productfile.yaml fields in Open Company spec v0. This version URL is immutable.
